Senior engineer and master's supervisor at the Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences. Their long-standing research focuses on intelligent remote-sensing data processing and information mining, with expertise in algorithm development, data product generation, and remote-sensing applications. They received a PhD in Cartography and Geographic Information Systems in 2016. Their current interests include remote-sensing image processing, temporal data mining, land-surface water extraction, and water quality monitoring. They have participated in projects under the National Key Research and Development Program, the Second Tibetan Plateau Scientific Expedition and Research program, key projects of the National Natural Science Foundation of China, and the CAS Strategic Priority Research Program, building experience in change detection, long-term remote-sensing product generation, and multi-source data fusion. The global land-surface water product they developed was included in the 2024 global sustainable development data products collection and continues to support global water governance and decision-making. They have published five monographs and more than 20 papers, applied for five invention patents, and received a first prize in the 2025 Geoinformation Science and Technology Progress Awards.
